decision.source_text: we can remove that requirement if we can't do it with just me
decision.effect: The repository owner may authorize every artifact-scoped action role. No action or review produced under this amendment is described as independent.

supersedes.role_incompatibility: The same exact owner actor may hold method-schema-steward, port-implementer, oracle-held-out-custodian, and release-attestor action roles for this child only.

preserves: strict signature verification over the complete action
release-attestor action role for any publication request
exact company, project, laboratory, repository, artifact, base-policy, and amendment binding
unused durable nonces and replay denial
authoritative role and revocation snapshots supplied outside candidate evidence
no publication or protected evaluator access in US-001
fail_closed: Absent, mismatched, expired, revoked, replayed, or non-owner amendment actions deny promotion without state mutation.
